name: w-trade-adaptivess
description: A framework for searching adaptive strategy-picking policies over a quantitative-trading strategy library: a no-lookahead evaluator (pick contract, ledger, nulls and diagnostics), agentic nodes that write picking modules, an agentic dream that audits and synthesizes, and a controller layer, all running on the recursive search engine w-recursi.
author: yuda-lyu(semisphere)
